newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK C.BANK CROWN/DOLLAR FIX AT 30.954 (30.937).
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK C.BANK CROWN/DOLLAR FIX AT 30.954 (30.937).

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) fixed the crown at 30.954 to the dollar after Thursday's fixing at 30.937, and at 20.502 to the mark from 20.510.
The crown fixing is announced daily at about 1140 CET (1040 GMT), and is within plus/minus 5.0 percent of a dollar/mark basket midpoint calculated at exactly 11:30:00 CET.
The above rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of -0.49 percent, after a deviation of -0.49 percent on Thursday.
